title: The Talking Box
stage: daily ornament; Windows silent tests passed; Pi and participant tests pending

panels.box: Another sunrise. Still no leaves. Terrible benefits.
Morning, sleepyhead! Your daily dose of fabulous has arrived.

panels.person: It's too early for this much confidence.
panels.box: Modesty? Sorry, this box is full of talent.

panels.person: I'm starting work. Try to behave.

panels.box: How about a walk? You're growing roots. That's MY job.
Go on. I'll guard the desk. Heroically.

self_talk: Another busy day of being decorative. I may need an assistant.
I've been standing here doing nothing. Somehow, it suits me.
This desk needed a personality. You're welcome.
I considered being useful. Briefly. It passed.
Still no leaves. At this point, I suspect management.
A very important thought just crossed my mind. It waved and left.
I bring a lot to this room. Mostly myself.
If anyone asks, we have both been extremely productive.
I've rearranged absolutely nothing. The place looks fantastic.
Some people have a rich inner life. I have excellent corners.
I was going to make a grand entrance. Then I remembered I live here.
Look at us. Two fascinating objects near a desk.
The view hasn't changed much. Luckily, I'm in it.
I have no appointments today. Being this interesting takes time.
Quiet again. Good. My dramatic pause was getting interrupted.
I'm not staring. This is simply where my face is.
replies: Oh, you talk to the decorations now. Excellent taste.
You had the whole room, and you chose me. Understandable.
A bold contribution from someone with so many elbows.
I would nod thoughtfully, but I've committed to this shape.
There you go, giving the furniture a social life.
Careful. Keep talking to me and I'll expect a tiny name tag.
I had a clever response ready. Then I got distracted by myself.
You sound very animated for someone who can actually sit down.
Look at us having a conversation. The lamp must be furious.
I'd give you a round of applause. Bit of an equipment shortage.
Well, that was certainly a use of your indoor voice.
You make an excellent audience. Mostly because you're here.
I see you've discovered my premium feature: more talking.
Please hold. My one imaginary employee is on a break.
You brought words. I brought presence. Fair exchange.
And here I thought I was the chatty object in this room.
Very engaging. You should tell that to something with eyebrows.
I don't have much to add. That has never stopped me before.
It's nice having a visitor who doesn't need watering. Probably.
If this is small talk, I'm exceptionally well qualified.
You've caught me at a good time. All of my time is decorative.
Such confidence. Have you considered becoming a desk ornament?
I'd lean in, but that would become a whole incident.
You may continue. I'm already standing here.
